exam_facts.result: Lesions consistent with Progressive Multifocal Encephalopathy (PML).

exam_facts.test: T1/T2 images showing multifocal demyelinating lesions without gadolinium enhancement, indicative of PML.

Sodium 139 mmol/L; potassium 4.2 mmol/L; creatinine 0.7 mg/dL; eGFR 98 mL/min/1.73m²; albumin 3.6 g/dL; AST 22 U/L; ALT 18 U/L; total bilirubin 0.6 mg/dL
Color pale yellow; clarity clear; specific gravity 1.015; pH 6.0; no protein, glucose, blood, or leukocyte esterase; 0–1 WBC/hpf, 0 RBC/hpf, no casts

1.8 (positive, but not used for exclusion — included here as baseline serostatus; note: this is *not* a confirmatory test per se, but required context for PML risk stratification and is routinely obtained pre-natalizumab and at follow-up)
